# coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formal proofs (31 theorem bundles `T1a`–`T3l` + 9 adversarial boundary tests, 34 audited declarations + 1,330 `TriadFrontier.*` declarations swept by `AuditExhaustiveAxioms.lean`, 4,337 `con-leche`/`con-ron` verified decls across 6 independent kernels + live negative tamper gate), hardened C11 (87 tests + 1,024 fuzz) / Python (`0 ruff`, `0 mypy`, 25 tests, 14/14 mutants) / Eshkol v1.3.6 AD multi-language verifiers, dual DigiCert RFC 3161 + 3-calendar Bitcoin OTS timestamps, a CSP/WCAG-AA interactive GitHub Pages Proof Blueprint, and an AMS-LaTeX preprint (`v5.1.0`, 8 figures, 36 live HTTP-200 + 0-retraction Crossref citations). Resolves no published open problem in Lean and refutes no published claim; see `ERRATA.md` for the 2026-11-26 statement audit and `v5.1.0` fixes (`A01`–`A12`, `L01`, `L03`–`L06`, `S02`–`S04`).

- Author: Alexander S. Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)
- Code License: Apache-2.0 | Docs & Paper License: CC-BY-4.0
- Interactive Proof Blueprint: https://0thernes.github.io/coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab/

## Primary Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, plain-language Lean vs. outside-Lean table (`T1a`–`T3l`), verbatim 34-declaration Lean axiom audit, and quickstart.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Claim-by-claim ledger (`C1`–`C31`), open frontiers (`O1`–`O7`), and falsification protocol.
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Explicit non-claims, formal vs. computational boundaries, and real-vs-metaphor breakdown.
- [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md): Versioned errata, 2026-11-26 statement audit, `v5.1.0` fixes (`A01`–`A12`, `L01`, `L03`–`L06`, `S02`–`S04`), and open scope items (`v1.0.0`–`v5.1.0`).
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-room replication commands and zero-cache verification log.
- [HARDENING_LOG.md](HARDENING_LOG.md): 38 defects/issues found and resolved across audit cycles (`H01`–`H38`).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions for AI coding agents.

## Technical Artifacts
- [lean/Solution.lean](lean/Solution.lean): Master zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 solution (`T1a`–`T3l`).
- [lean/AuditExhaustiveAxioms.lean](lean/AuditExhaustiveAxioms.lean): Programmatic `Lean.collectAxioms` sweep across all 1,330 `TriadFrontier.*` declarations.
- [lean/TriadFrontier/PIRLinearCerts.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/PIRLinearCerts.lean): 23 $\mathbb{F}_2/\mathbb{F}_3$ linear rays, 510 four-marginals, 6 five-object $\mathbb{F}_2$ realizations (`T1i`), & 6-object $\mathbb{F}_2^{64}$ realization (`T1j`; rank routines cross-checked in C/Python).
- [lean/TriadFrontier/MLWETightness.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/MLWETightness.lean): `T2a`–`T2i`, incl. integer Bai DPI/tensorization inequalities & 14-bit `Dyadic-16384-A/B` moment certificates.
- [lean/TriadFrontier/KoszulTensor.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/KoszulTensor.lean): Field-universal Koszul flattening tensor rank bounds (`T3e`, `T3g`).
- [lean/TriadFrontier/StrassenWinograd.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/StrassenWinograd.lean): Characteristic-free formalization of known $\mathrm{rank}_F(\langle 2,2,2\rangle) = 7$ over every field (`T3h`).
- [lean/TriadFrontier/BrockettDobkin.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/BrockettDobkin.lean): Field-universal substitution-method rectangular & quadratic $2m^2-m$ MatMul lower bound + Strassen lift (`T3i`; weaker than Brockett–Dobkin $2m^2-1$).
- [lean/TriadFrontier/ShannonCapacity.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/ShannonCapacity.lean): Field-universal Haemers rank bound, zero-reals $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{5}]$ SOS integer form of Lovász $\Theta(C_5)=\sqrt{5}$, & exact $C_7$ min Haemers rank $= 4$ (`T3j`).
- [lean/TriadFrontier/AlgebraicComplexity.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/AlgebraicComplexity.lean): Constructive Schwartz–Zippel lemma & two-sided Strassen bound $2\cdot 4^k - 2^k \le \mathrm{rank}_F(\langle 2^k,2^k,2^k\rangle) \le 7^k$ (`T3k`).
- [lean/TriadFrontier/PaleyCapacity.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/PaleyCapacity.lean): Conditional zero-reals $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{p}]$ conference-matrix SOS theorem (Lovász 1979; hypotheses proved in Lean for $P_5, P_{13}, P_{17}$, `T3l`).
- [lean/TriadFrontier/AdversarialTests.lean](lean/TriadFrontier/AdversarialTests.lean): 9 kernel-checked boundary tests (`adv_all_boundary_refutations`).
- [lean/VerifyAxioms.lean](lean/VerifyAxioms.lean): Strict `#print axioms` audit script (34 declarations).
- [lean/formalization.yaml](lean/formalization.yaml): Machine-readable formalization registry metadata.
- [docs/site/blueprint.html](docs/site/blueprint.html): CSP/WCAG-AA interactive 31-theorem Proof Blueprint DAG.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): System and mathematical dependency architecture.
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Line-by-line Lean-to-paper statement fidelity table.
- [docs/LITERATURE_SEARCH.md](docs/LITERATURE_SEARCH.md): Logged prior-art search & Crossref 0-retraction audit.
- [docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md](docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md): Honest Mega-Atlas crosswalk (`0 / 1,900` grand problems retired).
- [docs/SUBMISSION_PACKET.md](docs/SUBMISSION_PACKET.md): Export-control, AI-disclosure & preservation packet.
- [dist/Donahue_2026_coded_pir_mlwe_complexity_frontier.pdf](dist/Donahue_2026_coded_pir_mlwe_complexity_frontier.pdf): Frozen AMS-LaTeX preprint (`v5.1.0`).
